title: Hall, Richard. "Is the CIA Stonewalling?" Frontiers of Science. June 30, 1981
doc_notes: This document is an article by Richard Hall discussing government UFO records and potential national security threats, containing summaries of several specific encounter reports.

encounters.summary: UFOs observed near the flight line of Cannon AFB, New Mexico, described as 25 yards in diameter, gold or silver with a blue light on top, a hole in the middle, and a red light on the bottom.

Iranian F-4 jets encountered UFOs that caused instrumentation and communication failure, and rendered weapons-control panels inoperable. The DIA noted radar confirmation and physiological effects on crew.
A UFO appeared over northern oil fields in Kuwait, causing automatic pumping equipment to shut down and then restart automatically when the object vanished.
A USAF Security Service intercept technician reported that a Cuban MIG-21 pilot attempted to fire at a UFO and was subsequently destroyed by the object.
